notes.title: ✈️ A Simple Job: Airlines – Final Teaser! ✈️
notes.content:
[h2]This is the last teaser before you board the plane! 🛫[/h2]
In the coming days, we’ll also share a big announcement with the exact release date. You’ll get a sneak peek at the new achievements waiting for you on this wild flight, and we’ll reveal more about our future plans for A Simple Job. As always, the community will play an important role in shaping the journey. ❤️

[b]What to expect:[/b]

[b]🛩️ Fly the plane yourself![/b]
Yes, you read that right you’ll actually get behind the controls. Was it meant to happen this way? Well… not exactly. But that’s what makes it fun. 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619249/74f875dc68b9143b39b834636620614dc6ac37e9.jpg[/img]

[b]🌍 Multiple Endings[/b]
The DLC will feature different story outcomes. One of them is already teased in the image here – but where exactly did we end up? 🤔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619249/031072af10b6a70faf0ab3f579d0b32f3ce5e38c.jpg[/img]

[b]💻 A PC inside the game[/b]
For the sharp-eyed among you: this PC isn’t just decoration. There’s more than one password and more than one secret to uncover. Many different interactions await you. Maybe you’ll even end up playing another game… inside the game. 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619249/685d6355105e782eb2d81ed8d92d9bb0eb804647.jpg[/img]

We’re super excited and hope you are too!
👉 Don’t forget to wishlist the DLC on Steam so you won’t miss any updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3829860/A_simple_job__airlines/

notes.title: Subtitles & Vacation Mode! 🎉
notes.content:
[h2]English subtitles are here![/h2]

[b]Finally! The game now features full English subtitles.[/b]
Every whisper, mumble, and unhinged scream can now be read as well as heard.
Yes, even the voice has subtitles now. Sorry... maybe? 👀

[b]Performance improvements![/b]
We did another round of tuning under the hood.
Smoother gameplay, fewer hiccups. More button-pressing, less stuttering.

[b]DLC prep in progress ✈️[/b]
Work on the next chapter – “A Simple Job: Airlines” – is already underway.
But first: a short break from buttons and chaos.
(It’s research. Looking at planes. Totally legit.)

[b]More DLC news coming soon![/b]
We won’t leave you in the dark...
Well, not this time, anyway.
Expect more updates soon – and as always: be loud, be persistent. We love yelling back. 😅

Robin Hoffmann – DreamStudios

notes.title: 💬 Wait… an update for the base game?!
notes.content:
[h2]“But you said no more updates!”[/h2]
True – we meant no more content. But that doesn’t mean we won’t polish things up a bit! 😄
So here’s a tiny update with a couple of improvements – and a little teaser for the upcoming DLC!

[h2]🆕 What’s new?[/h2]

[b]🛠️ Revamped Main Menu![/b]
The main menu got a fresh coat of paint and now includes a shiny new DLC selection screen.
There’s nothing there yet – but it’s all set up and ready for what’s coming.
Think of it as a sneak peek to get hyped!

[b]🎁 DLC Teaser Included:[/b]
We’re working hard on it, and while we don’t want to make you wait too long,
we also want it to be worth your time. So, here’s a little taste in advance.

[h2]🔧 Minor but mighty hotfixes:[/h2]

[b]🔊 Widescreen audio fix:[/b]
Some players with ultrawide monitors couldn’t hear certain sounds (like that voice 😱).
No more silence – now you’ll get the full spooky audio experience, no matter how wide your screen is.

[b]💾 Settings now save properly (lol):[/b]
Yeah… they didn’t before.
Now they do. You’re welcome. 😂

[h2]🧱 What’s next?[/h2]
We’re pouring our hearts, minds, and slightly chaotic energy into the DLC.
We want it to be as ridiculous and awesome as possible – without making you wait forever.

❤️ Thanks again for all your support –
This madness only exists because of you. And don’t worry:

It won’t get better.
Only weirder. 😈

– Robin & Saturn91
DreamStudios 🌀

notes.title: 🆕 A Simple Job – First DLC in Development!
notes.content:
[h2]A new job. More chaos. Same voice. Just... different.[/h2]

[b]You thought you had the job figured out?[/b]
Think again.
The first DLC for A Simple Job is currently in development! 🎉
Get ready for new settings, fresh chaos, and even more reasons not to press the button. Or to press it. 👀

[b]🎯 Your Mission: Make the DLC Free![/b]
We’ve got a simple task for you – and for once, it doesn’t involve the button:
If we hit 100 Steam reviews this month...

[b]🔓 Everyone gets the DLC for FREE[/b]
🚀 And we’ll start working on DLC #2 right away (yep, that one will be paid – gotta fund the madness)

[b]If we don’t make it:[/b]
💸 The first DLC will release as planned – for the price of a humble energy drink
🛑 And then... we stop. No updates. No second DLC. Just silence.
(Okay, the button stays. Obviously.)

[b]🔧 One Last Thing...[/b]
Before the DLC drops, we’re putting together one final, glorious update for the base game.
A thank-you. A goodbye.
Or maybe... a warning. 😏

[h2]📦 What’s in the DLC?[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🗺️ A whole new setting
[*] 💥 Brand-new ways to mess everything up
[*] 🏆 More achievements – some fun, some evil
[*] 🎙️ The same voice... just a bit off. Maybe sleep-deprived. Maybe completely unhinged. Maybe both.
[/list]

💸 And the price? About as much as a can of energy.
(Fuel your chaos.)

[b]So here’s your job now:[/b]
🔁 Leave a review
🎯 Hit the goal
🔴 And don’t press the button
(Or do. For science.)

notes.title: 📢 Changelog & outlook
notes.content:
[p]First of all, a huge [b]thank you[/b] for your amazing feedback – you all are incredible! 🎉
We got to work right away and have already optimized a few things. Meanwhile, we’re also working hard on a small [b]content update[/b] that will be released [b]tomorrow[/b]! 🛠️✨
We want to keep developing [i]A Simple Job[/i] together with you – so:
[b]Tell us your wishes![/b]
Whether it’s core improvements, absurd gameplay ideas, or brand-new jobs – everything is welcome.
A basketball hoop? A button with a personality? Or an office with... even more chaos? 🏀💥
Get creative – the coolest ideas might (maybe) make it straight into the game! 😈

💡 [b]And don’t worry:[/b] As long as you’re playing [i]A Simple Job[/i], [b]we’ll keep delivering new content[/b] – no matter how crazy, absurd, or pointless it may be. The more you press, the more you get back. Promise. 😇🔴

[b]🛠️ Mini-Update – 07. June 🔧[/b]

We’ve got a small but sweet update for you:

[b]🥇 New Achievement:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] A brand-new achievement is here – and it lets you mess with the boss a little.
[/p][/*][*][p] But be careful: We hope he doesn’t come back twice as fast... 😈
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]📺 Windowed Mode Option:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] You can now play in windowed mode! You’ll find it in the settings – that means the Settings room. Have fun clicking in and out.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]🗺️ Room Display:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] From now on, the game will show which room you’re in in the top right corner. No more getting lost (well... in theory).
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]🏆 Achievement Help:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Room specific achievements now show which room you can find them in. Because we know how much you hate searching. 😉 [/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]📚 Community Guide:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Two of you maniacs actually made a guide on Steam! We love it – and we love you. Thanks for being our test subjects... and yes, you pressed the button. Of course you did. 🔴💥 (you might want to update the guide now for that new achievement xD) [/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]🛠️ More Fixes & Improvements:[/b]

[b]🧱 Ceiling fixed:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Now you can only leave the map on purpose. No more unauthorized flying adventures! 😅 - I see you misterM![/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]🎍Plant repaired:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] You can no longer walk through the plant like it’s air. (Jesus why is there always one collider missing!) [/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]🖼️ Sleep window improved:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Looks way better on wide screens now – some parts weren’t displaying properly before. Now enjoy sweeter dreams in better resolution. 😌✨
[/p][/*][/list][p]
Thanks for playing and for all your support!
Stay weird – and don’t touch the button. Or... maybe do?

[/p]
